compiled_state.title: Bootstrap host project and configure for E2E CI llm-review verification
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Summary
Bootstrap a fresh host project via create-dso-app.sh in a temporary directory, patch dso-config.conf to enable merge.strategy=pr, and verify the bootstrapped project is ready for E2E CI verification.

## Testing Mode
RED — new behavior (E2E verification script that exercises the fetched-assets runner mode branch).

## Acceptance Criteria
- GIVEN create-dso-app.sh is invoked in $RUNNER_TEMP
  WHEN the bootstrap completes
  THEN a valid .claude/dso-config.conf is present with merge.strategy=pr (manually patched)
- GIVEN the bootstrapped project
  WHEN the CI workflow runs
  THEN the Resolve-and-fetch step uses tier 3 (marketplace.json HEAD pin) to resolve the DSO plugin version
- Prerequisite checks are explicit: if gh auth scope insufficient, Anthropic API creds absent, or create-dso-app.sh exits non-zero, the test FAILS with a clear log message (never silently passes)
- Bootstrap is idempotent: re-running when $RUNNER_TEMP already contains the project skips bootstrap and patches config if needed

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh (new test script)
- .test-index (add RED marker: tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh [test_host_bootstrap_and_config_patch])

## Implementation Notes
- Use `create-dso-app.sh --non-interactive` or equivalent quiet flag if available
- Patch command: `sed -i 's/^merge\.strategy=.*/merge.strategy=pr/' .claude/dso-config.conf`
- Prerequisite guard: `gh auth status` exit code + `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` env check before proceeding
- Store bootstrapped project path in a temp state file for use by the next task

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh exists and is executable. Verify: `test -x tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script invokes create-dso-app.sh (or its installer entry point) in a temp directory derived from $RUNNER_TEMP with mktemp fallback. Verify: `grep -E 'RUNNER_TEMP|mktemp' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script patches the bootstrapped project's .claude/dso-config.conf to set merge.strategy=pr AND model.provider=anthropic (OpenAI quota is exhausted as of 2026-05-01 — must use Anthropic). Verify: `grep -E 'merge.strategy=pr' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh && grep -E 'model.provider=anthropic' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script asserts prerequisites and FAILs loudly when missing: gh auth status, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exported, create-dso-app.sh exit 0. Verify: `grep -E 'gh auth status|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script is idempotent: re-running when the temp project already exists skips bootstrap and only re-applies the config patch. Verify: `grep -E 'idempotent|already exists|skip bootstrap' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] .test-index has a RED marker entry: `tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh [test_host_bootstrap_and_config_patch]`. Verify: `grep -F 'tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh [test_host_bootstrap_and_config_patch]' .test-index`
- [ ] Test passes when run with valid prereqs and fails fast with a clear message when prereqs are missing.

## File Impact

- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh (NEW)
- .test-index (MODIFIED — add RED marker)
